fields.name: Despina
fields.role: UI/UX Designer and Full Stack Developer
fields.intro: I turn ideas into clean, modern interfaces that feel smooth, intuitive and visually striking.
fields.about: I'm a full stack developer and UI/UX designer based in Enugu, Nigeria, and I love turning ideas into interfaces that look great and feel effortless to use. I design in Figma and bring those designs to life in React and Django, so clients get a smooth path from concept to working product. I can take a project from a first wireframe to a polished, responsive website or mobile app without the usual gaps between design and development.

fields.question: What services do you offer?
fields.answer: I design and develop modern websites and mobile interfaces, focusing on clean UI, smooth user experience, and responsive frontend development.

fields.question: How much do your services cost?
fields.answer: My pricing ranges from $10 to $3000 depending on project size, complexity, and estimated delivery timeline.

fields.question: Do you build full websites or only design?
fields.answer: I can both design interfaces and develop frontend websites, depending on what the project requires.

fields.question: How long does a project take?
fields.answer: Delivery time depends on the scope of the project, but most projects typically take anywhere from a few days to a few weeks.

fields.question: What tools do you use for your work?
fields.answer: I mainly use Figma for design and React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for frontend development.

fields.question: Can you redesign an existing website?
fields.answer: Yes, I can improve or completely redesign existing websites to make them more modern, responsive, and user-friendly.

fields.question: Do you work with clients internationally?
fields.answer: Yes, I work with clients from different countries and communicate remotely throughout the entire project process.

fields.question: What do you need to start a project?
fields.answer: I usually need a clear idea of the project, any references or inspirations, and your required features or goals.

fields.question: Can you maintain or update my website?
fields.answer: Yes, I can help with ongoing maintenance, updates, and improvements after the initial project is completed.

fields.question: How do we communicate during a project?
fields.answer: We can communicate through email, WhatsApp, or any preferred platform to ensure smooth updates and feedback.
